subject: Intro + demo request from Azure Marketplace listing (Schelper)
messages:
From: Alyssa Barnes <alyssa@schelper.io>
To: diego.fernandez@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 22 Oct 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Redwood listing on Azure Marketplace — interested in a quick demo

Hi Diego,

We found Redwood on the Azure Marketplace (listing ID 9f3a) and I wanted to reach out — my team is evaluating inference platforms to reduce our per-token cost and get better latency for customer-facing features. I already created an account and started a trial, but would appreciate a quick walkthrough to understand:

- how Redwood Dedicated maps to Azure VMs/services,
- what migration steps from our current hosted endpoints look like, and
- pricing/committing options for reserved capacity.

Would love a 30-minute intro/demo this week if you have availability. Our team is in PDT (San Francisco). Attaching our initial procurement checklist (PDF).

Thanks,
Alyssa Barnes
Sr. Product Manager, Schelper
alyssa@schelper.io
attachment: schelper_procurement_checklist.pdf (application/pdf)
From: diego.fernandez@redwood.com <diego.fernandez@redwood.com>
To: Alyssa Barnes <alyssa@schelper.io>
Date: Thu, 22 Oct 2026 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Redwood listing on Azure Marketplace — interested in a quick demo

Hi Alyssa — great to hear from you and thanks for trying Redwood from the Marketplace. I can definitely walk through Dedicated vs Hosted and our reserved capacity commitments. A few quick Qs before we lock time:

1) Is your primary goal latency/cost optimization or data isolation for regulated workloads?
2) How many concurrent inference QPS do you anticipate for the initial rollout?

I have these 30-minute slots open (PDT):
- Thu 10/22 1:00–1:30pm
- Fri 10/23 9:30–10:00am
- Mon 10/26 11:00–11:30am

If none of those work, feel free to pick a time on my calendar: https://cal.redwood.com/diego/30. I'll invite Marissa (AE) and Karthik (Solutions Eng) to the call so we can cover procurement and an architecture walkthrough.

Attached a one-pager that summarizes our Dedicated offering.

Best,
Diego Fernandez
SDR — Midmarket Sales, Redwood Inference
diego.fernandez@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0199
attachment: redwood_30min-demo-onepager.pdf (application/pdf)
From: Alyssa Barnes <alyssa@schelper.io>
To: diego.fernandez@redwood.com
Cc: Markus Green <markus_g@schelper.io>
Date: Thu, 22 Oct 2026 10:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Redwood listing on Azure Marketplace — interested in a quick demo

Thanks Diego — aiming mostly for latency and cheaper per-token cost; we also have some data residency constraints but not full-regulated. Initial peak target is ~200 QPS, likely ramping after launch.

Fri 10/23 9:30–10:00am PDT works for us. Markus (CC'd) is our infra lead and will join for the architecture portion.

Also FYI: procurement asked to see standard T&Cs and a sample SOC2 report during the demo — can Marissa have those ready?

See you Friday,
Alyssa
From: diego.fernandez@redwood.com <diego.fernandez@redwood.com>
To: Alyssa Barnes <alyssa@schelper.io>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 22 Oct 2026 11:10:00 -0700

Perfect — calendar invite sent for Fri 10/23 9:30–10:00am PDT. Inviting Marissa (AE) for procurement/T&Cs and Karthik (SE) for the infra/arch dive.

Agenda (30m):
- 5m intros + what Schelper is building
- 10m product demo (Hosted vs Dedicated, routing/caching)
- 10m architecture + Q&A (KV cache, batching, quantization options)
- 5m next steps / procurement checklist

I've attached our SOC 2 summary and a link to the full security package; Marissa will follow up with standard T&Cs during the meeting.

HubSpot record: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/companies/67890 (I'll log notes).

See you Friday — invite includes a .ics.

Thanks,
Diego
